      "SELECT menu_id AS \"ID\", item_name AS \"Item\", category AS \"Category\", price AS \"Price\", CASE WHEN availability THEN \'Yes\' ELSE \'No\' END AS \"Available\" FROM menu ORDER BY menu_id"
      private static final String
      ORDERS_QUERY
      "SELECT o.order_id AS \"Order\", TO_CHAR(s.sale_time, \'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM\') AS \"Time\", m.item_name AS \"Item\", o.quantity AS \"Qty\", s.total_amount AS \"Total\" FROM orders o JOIN sale s ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN menu m ON o.menu_id = m.menu_id ORDER BY s.sale_time DESC LIMIT 100"
      private static final String
      SALES_BY_ITEM_QUERY
      "WITH order_sales AS ( SELECT order_id, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM sale WHERE sale_time >= ? AND sale_time < ? GROUP BY order_id ), item_sales AS ( SELECT o.menu_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.quantity) AS quantity_sold, SUM(os.revenue) AS revenue FROM order_sales os JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = os.order_id GROUP BY o.menu_id ) SELECT m.item_name, m.category, COALESCE(i.orders, 0) AS orders, COALESCE(i.quantity_sold, 0) AS quantity_sold, COALESCE(i.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM menu m LEFT JOIN item_sales i ON i.menu_id = m.menu_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, m.item_name"

      private static final String
      CASHIER_QUERY
      "SELECT e.employee_name, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(s.total_amount) AS sales\nFROM sale s\nJOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id\nWHERE s.sale_time >= ? AND s.sale_time < ?\nGROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name\nORDER BY sales DESC\n"
      private static final String
      CATEGORY_QUERY
      "SELECT m.category, SUM(o.quantity) AS drinks, SUM(s.total_amount) AS sales\nFROM sale s\nJOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id\nJOIN menu m ON m.menu_id = o.menu_id\nWHERE s.sale_time >= ? AND s.sale_time < ?\nGROUP BY m.category\nORDER BY sales DESC\n"
      private static final String
      HOURLY_QUERY
      "SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM sale_time)::int AS hour,\n COUNT(*) AS orders,\n SUM(total_amount) AS sales\nFROM sale\nWHERE sale_time >= ? AND sale_time < ?\nGROUP BY hour\nORDER BY hour\n"

AS large_drinks,\n COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.toppings IS NOT NULL AND o.toppings <> \'\') AS toppings_added,\n MIN(s.sale_time) AS first_sale,\n MAX(s.sale_time) AS last_sale\nFROM sale s\nJOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id\nWHERE s.sale_time >= ? AND s.sale_time < ?\n"
